species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 62°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northeast wind at 13 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
